text:
I’m passionate, hard-working, and I bring extensive experience in data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization. I also work comfortably with SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets, which helps me turn messy marketing data into clear, practical insights.

For a project like yours, I’d focus on making your Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Twitter, and YouTube marketing efforts easier to measure and improve. That means organizing campaign data, building reporting views that are easy to understand, and helping identify which channels are driving the strongest performance so you can make better decisions faster.

A relevant example of my work is **Warehouse models for a DTC brand (Fernwood Pantry)**, where I built a dbt project with staging, intermediate, and mart layers for orders, subscriptions, and marketing. The work included **38 models**, tests on **120 columns**, and a dashboard refresh that moved from **daily to hourly**. That project shows my ability to structure data cleanly and create reporting that supports timely decision-making.

I also worked on **Marketing attribution analysis (Verdant Skincare)**, where I joined ad platform spend with GA4 sessions in BigQuery to compare first-click, last-click, and position-based credit. As a result, **18% of the ad budget was reallocated** and **customer acquisition cost went down 12% the next quarter**. That experience is directly relevant to paid social marketing, because it focused on understanding channel contribution and improving spend allocation.

If you’re looking for someone who can bring clarity to your marketing data and help you track performance across platforms, I’d be glad to help. I’m comfortable working with marketing datasets, cleaning and structuring them, and building dashboards that make performance easier to monitor and act on.

I’d welcome the chance to discuss your goals and how I can support your Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Twitter, and YouTube promotion efforts.
